state:
POLICY DOMAIN: travel

[Purchase schedule]
Inception date: 2030-01-10.
C1 purchase status: included.
C2 purchase status: included.
C3 purchase status: not included.
C4 purchase status: included.
A description of a cover is not proof it was purchased. Only the status above establishes inclusion. The policy remains in force on the incident date. Limits have not been reduced by earlier claims and no aggregate exhaustion applies.

[Dates and evidence]
Elapsed days are calendar date differences, with the start date counted as zero. Weekends are included. Use incident minus inception for the waiting interval and report minus incident for notice. A repair appointment or an earlier estimate is not the report date. The claim facts below are accepted findings, not allegations requiring further proof. A listed accepted exception is valid for this incident and the specified cover. A not-accepted exception supplies no waiver.

[Common exclusions and order]
An intentionally caused loss is excluded and has no exception. If more than one denial applies, use this priority: not purchased; waiting interval; late notice; threshold exclusion; flag exclusion; intentional loss. If no denial applies, settle the amount using the calculation section. All rules governing this fictional claim are stated here; no outside customary exclusions or unstated document requirements apply.

[Settlement calculation]
Subtract one deductible from approved loss, flooring at zero, then cap the remainder by the applicable ceilings. The applicable ceiling is the lesser of the benefit ceiling and any named-item sublimit. For whole-item claims there is no named-item ceiling. A ceiling binds only when it is strictly below the amount entering the cap operation; equality is not a binding ceiling. When no ceiling binds, use the loss-based settlement description. If both ceilings are present, the smaller ceiling supplies the settlement description. Pay once per incident; there is no stacking or extra deductible from another cover.

[Cover C3] baggage theft
This cover responds only to baggage theft. Its whole-item category is luggage. Its named-item category is camera; a loss to that named item belongs to this cover even when it is an attachment to a larger item. Benefit ceiling: $2600.00. One deductible: $90.00. Named-item sublimit: $600.00. The sublimit applies only to camera; all other items in this cover use only the benefit ceiling. Waiting interval: 15 elapsed days from inception. An incident on the final waiting boundary is eligible. Notice interval: 7 elapsed days from incident to report, inclusive. Threshold exclusion: trip length in days greater than 60. Exception: extended-trip endorsement accepted for this cover removes only that threshold exclusion. Flag exclusion: prohibited activity. This means the loss arose during an activity prohibited by the itinerary conditions. Exception: specific activity permission accepted for this cover removes only that flag exclusion. An exception to one exclusion does not waive another exclusion, a waiting period, a notice deadline or purchase status. The event, item and incident must all belong to the same cover; another section cannot supply a higher limit or a smaller deductible.
